name: Taking a sale occurrence raises a distinct resale signal

statusDetails.message: SALE offer o2 taken by 3; billing names payer 3, occurrence o2, resale, v1 and house-resale-tariff; standing payer 12 and next-week holding remain.

labels.name: story
labels.value: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences

steps.name: Given: Given apartment 12 has released one Tuesday occurrence for sale
When: When apartment 3 buys that occurrence under the house's sale policy
Then: Then apartment 3 is the taker for that one Tuesday occurrence
Then: And a resale billing signal identifies apartment 3, that occurrence, the charge kind, the governing policy version and the house price reference
Then: And apartment 12's normal standing-slot fee remains due
Then: And apartment 12 still holds the standing slot on later Tuesdays
